newsitem.title: USA: Delta II rocket launch postponed.
newsitem.headline: Delta II rocket launch postponed.

text.p: The Air Force Friday postponed the launch of a Delta II rocket carrying the first five satellites for the IRIDIUM LLC communications project due to high, upper level winds.
Christine Nelson, a spokeswoman for McDonnell Douglas Corp, maker of the rocket, said the winds at between 20,000 feet and 50,000 feet were "beyond the safety parameters."
Nelson said a second attempt to launch the Delta II would be made on Saturday.
The planned launch is the first of a Delta II rocket since January, when a Delta II exploded shortly after take-off from Cape Canaveral, Fla.

IRIDIUM is an international consortium of 17 companies, including Motorola Inc, Sprint Corp, Lockheed Martin Corp, Raytheon Co and Pacific Electric Wire & Cable Co Ltd. The largest stakeholder is Motorola, with about 25 percent.
